rule: Every flagged query receives two fresh same-query-set pairs, before/after then reversed. Repeatable only if both new after/before mean ratios exceed1.10. No full-suite reruns.
limits: First-pass suite geometric means are retained unchanged.
Only first-pass flags receive paired repeats; missing or failed repeats cannot pass.
Comparisons of prerequisite-only cohorts are contextual, not independently submitted changes.
